lcc_original: 當洪流大水氾濫在地上的時候，挪亞正六百歲。
notes: UNV 洪<WH03999>水<WH04325> → LCC 洪流大水: split as 洪流<WH03999> (mabbul=flood) and 大水<WH04325> (mayim=waters); LCC expands with 流 but the semantic split holds cleanly.
UNV 整六<WH08337> → LCC 正六<WH08337>: 整 and 正 are both adverbs meaning 'exactly/just'; H8337 (שֵׁשׁ=six) attaches after 六 in both.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} remain braced implicit: LCC has no explicit verb for הָיָה here, parallel to UNV.
